name: Craftsman's Writ: Craftsman's Monocle
summary: A transferable writ requests a Craftsman's Monocle and gives details for delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the transaction.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The faded note asks you to obtain a Craftsman's Monocle for a customer. It also gives the delivery place and payment details. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need to possess it when completing the transaction.

faq.answer: The writ requests one Craftsman's Monocle for a customer.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the monocle?
faq.answer: The writ provides a delivery location, marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the transaction?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
